credentialBlocker: No validated iOS Distribution Certificate is attached to the EAS app credentials for a non-interactive first production build.
easError: Credentials are not set up. Run this command again in interactive mode.
requiredResolution: An authorized Apple Developer account holder must complete the first interactive iOS credentials setup in EAS, or upload an existing .p12 Distribution Certificate and matching .mobileprovision profile to the EAS project. After that one credential setup, the protected GitHub workflow can create future builds without manual workflow execution.
note: The command stopped during credential preparation before the project archive was uploaded or a build request/build ID was created. No submission command ran.
